title: ANTI-THEFT ALARM-DOOR JAMB, HOOD SWITCH & INST PNL WIRING
summary: RPO UA6 anti-theft alarm, front of car: the hood (alarm) switch on a bracket riveted to the cowl next to the windshield wiper motor, and the alarm harness that runs along the instrument panel harness to the LH and RH door jamb switches and the instrument-panel-to-body harness connector. The switch threads through the bracket and is tightened to 84-120 LBS IN; the bracket is held by rivets in two 7/32 holes; a lead plugs into the fuse panel receptacle marked BAT.

parts.name: SWITCH ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Switch assembly – anti-theft alarm hood switch

fastening.to: cowl, beside the windshield wiper motor
fastening.note: Rivets [4] go down through bracket [2] into two 7/32 dia holes in the cowl (holes located by the 1.74 / 1.50 / .75 dimensions).
Switch [1] mounts vertically through bracket [2] (switch body tightened to triangle 1, 84-120 LBS IN); its leads pass down through a 1/2 dia hole. No separate nut is called out.

fastening.to: instrument panel harness and fuse panel
fastening.note: Harness [3] is held by production clips and a production grommet along the instrument panel harness, connects at the instrument-panel-to-body harness connector, the LH and RH door jamb switches, the W/S washer ground connector and the W/S wiper ground terminal. View A: a lead (callout 1) plugs into the fuse panel receptacle marked BAT.

notes: NOTE Plug into fuse panel receptacle marked "BAT".
